subject: Television & Streaming
title: Live Streaming and Sports
description: A quick win: understand Live Streaming and Sports.

hook.text: Amazon paid $1 billion per year for Thursday Night Football. Live sports became streaming's ultimate prize.

buildup.text: Sports are the last content people reliably watch live. You can't time-shift a game without someone spoiling it.

discovery.text: Apple got Major League Soccer. Amazon got the NFL. Netflix got Christmas Day games. Every platform wants sports.

twist.text: Fans now need multiple apps just to follow one league. Cord-cutting was supposed to simplify, not fragment.

climax.text: Sports rights are so expensive that they're becoming the make-or-break factor in the streaming wars.

punchline.text: The future of streaming runs through the stadium.

quiz.question: Why are sports rights so valuable to streaming platforms?
options: Sports are among the last content watched live and in real time
